data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: merge-to-main-pr.sh commits the version-bump on the source branch's HEAD before initiating session\xe2\x86\x92main merge.
- DD2: The bump commit carries a provenance trailer (DSO-Story-Merge: or coordinated trailer).
- DD5: Sub-PR commit history shows version-bump on source branch (SC4(b)).
- DD6: Unit tests for all modified logic.

## Implementation Notes

Modify `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh` (and/or `test-merge-to-main-pr-resume-and-stale.sh` if the resume path needs coverage). The current tests cover the post-merge direct-to-main bump path; this RED test must assert the NEW source-branch path.

**Test approach (Given / When / Then)**:
- Given: a fixture session branch (`session/test-epic`) on a real ephemeral git repository with a `version` file (or pyproject.toml) at the bump target
- Given: the session branch is up to date with origin/main
- When: a new pre-merge pipeline phase is invoked (the phase that bumps version on source branch)
- Then: a new commit exists on the source branch HEAD with:
  - The version file modified (version bumped)
  - The commit message body contains a provenance trailer matching `^DSO-Story(-Merge)?: <story-id>` (compatible with S1.T5's extended verify-session-provenance.sh grep)
  - The commit is NOT yet on main (the merge has not yet fired)
- AND: when `_phase_version_bump` is invoked AFTER the merge (current post-merge phase), it detects the bump is already on the merged commit's history and becomes a no-op (does not double-bump)

The test must fail RED on the current merge-to-main-pr.sh implementation, because:
1. The pre-merge bump phase does not yet exist.
2. The post-merge `_phase_version_bump` still runs unconditionally and would create a second bump commit.

Add `.test-index` RED marker `[test_merge_to_main_pr_source_branch_bump]` for `plugins/dso/scripts/merge-to-main-pr.sh`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Tests | Class |
|-------------|--------|-------|-------|
| `tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh` | modify | (this IS the test) | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Test file modified with source-branch bump assertion
  Verify: grep -qE 'source.branch|session/.*bump' tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Test asserts trailer presence on the bump commit
  Verify: grep -qE 'DSO-Story|DSO-Story-Merge.*trailer' tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] Test is initially RED (pre-merge bump phase missing)
  Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-merge-to-main-pr.sh
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker
  Verify: grep '\[test_merge_to_main_pr_source_branch_bump\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
